text.description_html:
PBB-B2920, 2-3/4" x 2-3/4" Screen Door Spring Hinge

Full Surface Single Acting Spring Hinge for Screen Doors. Door flange is surface applied to door. Jamb flange is surface applied to door jamb.

PBB-B2920 Screen Door Spring Hinge allow doors to automatically return to the closed position (Self Closing). Packaged with #7 x 3/4" wood mounting screws.

The included Tension Tool is use to adjust spring tension. The Locking Pins hold the Spring in tension after it is set. These adjustable tension spring hinges allow you to determine how much closing force you apply to the door (how hard/fast the door self closes).

Specifications for the PBB-B2920 Screen Door Spring Hinge:

  • Material: Steel
  • Finish: Zinc Plated
  • Hinge Width: 2-3/4"
  • Hinge Height: 2-3/4"
  • Non-Handed
  • Adjustable Tension
  • Hinge Type: Full Surface
  • Door flange surface applied
  • Jamb flange surface applied
  • PBB SA8170 Dimensions Diagram (PDF)

Sold Individually.
